title: MCC 2020–2026, two minutes per instance
about: tididi-cnf and the latest exact competition entries across MCC 2020–2026, two minutes per instance. Every competition entry is included; repeated formulas use one fixed representative.

title: Two minutes per instance
about: tididi-cnf and the exact counters entered in the 2026 competition, two minutes per instance; an instance is solved when the solver printed its count in time.

title: One hour per instance
about: The same counters for an hour per instance on the 100 private instances of 2026; the 33 instances that no solver had finished before were not run and count as unsolved.

title: Compilation, two minutes per instance
about: tididi-cnf and four d-DNNF compilers, two minutes per instance; an instance is solved when the compiler wrote its circuit in time and the circuit's model count, checked independently, was right.
